cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiasm for the Digital Marketing Specialist position at Orac. With a background that blends digital marketing, technical SEO, and a passion for data-driven storytelling, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a company that values design, precision, and commercial impact.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress development. I manage client websites end-to-end, from keyword research to publishing, and use analytics tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics to inform decisions. This hands-on experience has taught me to see data not just as numbers, but as narratives that drive strategy.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my initiative and technical curiosity. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD), and optimized for AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO). This project demonstrates my ability to blend creativity with analytical thinking, and my comfort with AI tools to enhance efficiency.

I am particularly drawn to Orac's focus on customer insight and the full lead journey. My experience with CRM data and segmentation, combined with my campaign management skills across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, aligns well with the responsibilities of this role. I am eager to learn Salesforce Marketing Cloud and grow into owning the customer activation process.

What excites me most is the opportunity to work across European markets and contribute to year plans that balance acquisition and retention. I am a quick learner, commercially minded, and always curious about what AI can do for marketing.

Thank you for considering my application. I am confident that my blend of technical skills and marketing acumen would make me a valuable addition to your team. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Orac's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)

- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
